summary.text: Myron Dossett is a Republican state representative who has represented District 9 since 2007 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Myron Dossett was born in Pembroke, Kentucky.
His professional experience includes working as a business owner and as a magistrate on the Christian County Fiscal Court.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Agriculture Committee and serves on the Natural Resources and Energy, Transportation, and Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees.
